page.layout: One page of text, one column, running head at top. Below the text a printed ornament (fleuron, not text). Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: proficiamus: donec aliquando tandem stadio hujus vitæ confecto ad beatam illam metam cœlestis gloriæ pertingamus. Gratias denique agimus Magn. D.Rectori, Generosis D.D.Baronib. Spectabili Decano cæterisque Professoribus clarissimis, & Præceptoribus nostris, reverendis & summa observantia colendis, nec non studiosis Juvenibus lectissimis, commilitonibus optimis, quòd partim gravissimis negotiis posthabitis partim studiis ardentissimis sepositis, huic nostræ balbutienti orationi interesse non fuerint dedi-gnati[?]: Nos vicissim omnibus ac singulis, quæcunque à nobis humanitatis officia proficisci queant polliceмur. Dixi.

page.notes: The line "proficiamus:donecaliquandotandemstadiohu-" is run together in print with no spaces, so I have separated the words as they read: "proficiamus: donec aliquando tandem stadio hujus". The word "dedi-gnati" is printed with the second part hard to read; it is marked [?]. The word "polliceмur" is shown with a broken letter; the reading "pollicemur" is intended. The ornament below the text is a decorative fleuron, not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and at the right edge and is not transcribed.
